messages:
ravi: quick flag check  thinking of a lightweight onboarding "spotlight" that highlights sample projects on first run. keep it unobtrusive but obvious.

lana: love the idea. two placement options: a small inline ribbon above the projects grid, or a floating spotlight (focus ring + subtle backdrop) that points at the sample card.

taylor: spotlight is visually strong but may feel modal-like. ribbon is calmer and easier to dismiss. need to think keyboard and SR behaviour.

mike: from infra POV ribbon = fewer layout changes. spotlight requires portal layering and focus-trap logic. both doable but spotlight adds testing.

ravi: research snapshot: in hallway tests spotlight got 60% clickthrough vs 30% for ribbon, but several participants complained about trapping focus.

lana: can we do a hybrid? spotlight visual for mouse/touch, ribbon for keyboard/screen reader. use CSS media (prefers-reduced-motion) and detect keyboard users to choose.

taylor: hybrid makes sense. accessibility checklist: 1) anchor in DOM order, 2) visible focus states, 3) aria-live polite announcement on show, 4) dismiss stored in localStorage so it doesn't reappear every reload.

kelly: copy brainstorm: primary: "Launch sample project", alt: "Explore sample projects", dismiss button text: "Not now" (aria-label: "Dismiss onboarding spotlight"). prefer short CTAs.

mike: analytic events: onboarding.spotlight_impression, onboarding.spotlight_cta_click (props: project_slug), onboarding.spotlight_dismiss. plan A/B: variant=spotlight|ribbon for 10% of new orgs for 3 weeks.

ravi: good. engineering note: add feature flag onboarding_spotlight_experiment and a kill switch. be safe with rollout to existing orgs only if they haven't seen the onboarding sequence.

lana: visual note: spotlight radial should be 6px softer shadow, 8px padding, and not cover the top nav. ribbon should be 56px height on desktop, collapse to 72px stacked card on mobile. thumbnails need alt text: "Sample: {name} - {one line}".

taylor: small a11y nit: using "Not now" is fine visually but SR users may need explicit context. recommend hidden SR copy: "Dismiss onboarding spotlight, will not show again".

kelly: confirm experiment metrics: CTR on CTA, time-to-first-run (workspace created), 7-day retention, and NPS on onboarding micro-survey. also monitor support tickets mentioning onboarding.

mike: will add instrumentation. please add event schema to the ticket. sample event: {"event":"onboarding.spotlight_cta_click","org_id":"$org","project":"$slug"}.

ravi: dev tasks: 1) implement UI + responsive styles, 2) add focus/aria behaviour, 3) persist dismiss, 4) telemetry, 5) experiment flags. QA: keyboard nav, SR reads, high-zoom, low contrast.

lana: i'll upload updated figma frames with both states and the SR copy in the component variants.

taylor: scheduling 30m review after eng PR is up. pls include accessibility engineer.

onboard-bot: reminder: new ticket ONB-2314 created by ravi with checklist + figma link.

ravi: thanks all. let's keep the ribbon copy tight and spotlight animation subtle. follow up in the ticket with any microcopy tweaks. :sparkles:
